openItems.item: The contract defines no maintenance or non-0.24 release path; every surface is blocked until #1408 records MILESTONE-SUCCEEDED. A maintenance path needs a #1407 amendment first.

The release PR precedes #1423 and cannot consume an adjudication identity. Whether checking its products (version, rendered notes) against the record satisfies §8 condition 7, or the row needs an amendment, is undecided.

The release gate compares rebuilt bytes with C2-recorded hashes and fails closed where a build is not byte-reproducible (the benchmark generator stamps the run time). C2 must make these builds reproducible or retain the candidate bytes durably. B2's headline embeds its comparison with the headline on main, so its adjudicated hash must be computed against main as it will be at publication. Bot PR #1505 (benchmark headline) was closed unmerged (coordinator, 2026-10-07).

Recommended settings not enforceable by a workflow: environment-scoped NUGET_API_KEY with a main-only policy; branch protection without admin bypass and with tests (verification) required; a v* tag ruleset; github-pages deployments restricted to main; a red release-audit run treated as a gate bypass.

G3 is not closed on the candidate. Execution 2 (DETERMINISTIC, 2,137 AGREE-PASS) ran on d42d0313, before the S2 repairs changed the verifier and the committed oracle reports, so it establishes nothing for this candidate. C2 commits the parked records (branch evidence/g3-1135-exec-2, verified here against their ledger entry) and runs the protocol on the candidate, charged to regeneration-compute (amendment 1.2.0).

openItems.source: GitHub issue states at the freeze
openItems.item: Every child issue except #1276 is OPEN at the freeze, although its gate PRs merged; #1493 (fixed by R-TEXT #1497) is also OPEN. Terminal condition 1 needs every child other than #1408 closed with its closure evidence.

Ordinary CI and publish workflows request SDK '10.0.x' and use runner labels; hosted runner images cannot be pinned. The manifest records the SDK, runtime, and images observed in the candidate's own push run (platforms.runnerImages.observedAtFreeze), not a pin, and image or SDK drift produces no git change for the classifier to see. Only the G2 protocol pins SDK 10.0.401 / runtime 10.0.12. C2 records the realized SDK, runtime, ImageOS, and ImageVersion of every job.
openItems.status: DECIDED 2026-10-07 (ENVIRONMENT-OBSERVED-NOT-PINNED): accepted as observed, not pinned; no amendment; C2 records what each regeneration used.

openItems.item: C1 adds 86 tests to Calor.Compiler.Tests (eng/test-manifest.json expectedTotal 12,947 -> 13,033). The release-test-suites artifact for the candidate is the candidate's own suite (12,947 tests, 3 skipped); a run at a later commit includes the C1 tests and must say so.

No CI check blocks a later invalidating merge to main. C2 and A1 must run the classifier on <candidate>..<their commit> from a checkout of the C1 landing commit (the trust anchor; running it from the commit being judged lets that commit change the classifier), and record the verdict. Making it a required check is a maintainer decision.

invalidation.rangeCommand: From a checkout of the C1 landing commit (the trust anchor): CALOR_C1_CLASSIFY_TARGET=<full SHA> dotnet test tests/Calor.Compiler.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~CandidateManifestTests.RangeFromTheCandidateIsNotInvalidated (full clone with refs/remotes/origin/main fetched; without the variable the target is the newest commit that changes a C1 file)
invalidation.rule: Default deny. Every commit in <candidate>..<target> is diffed against each of its parents with renames off; one non-exempt path makes the verdict INVALID. See docs/plans/v0.24-c1-candidate.md.

releasability.rule: The generator fails unless the candidate declares the decided version and tag v<version> is absent or points at the candidate. A tag created later at another commit, or any version or notes change, invalidates the freeze.
